name: 64tass-langserv
description: Language support for 64tass MOS 6502 macro assembler

64tass.caseSensitive.description: Enable case-sensitive symbol matching (equivalent to 64tass -C flag). When disabled (default), symbols are case-insensitive.

64tass.cpu.markdownDescription: Target CPU, deciding which opcodes and register addressing modes are recognised. Mirrors 64tass's CPU selection flags. A `.cpu "..."` directive or a `; 64tass-langserv: cpu <name>` pragma in a file overrides this for that file and everything it `.include`s. Note there is no `6510`: the C64 CPU is `6502`, the NMOS set that includes the undocumented opcodes.

64tass.includePaths.markdownDescription: Extra directories to search for `.include` and `.binclude` files, mirroring 64tass's `-I` flag. The directory of the including file is always tried first; these are searched afterwards, in order. Relative paths are taken against the workspace root.

scripts.version-from-tag: node -e "const v = require('child_process').execSync('git describe --tags --abbrev=0').toString().trim().replace(/^v/, ''); const pkg = require('./package.json'); pkg.version = v; require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');"
